documentation.file_docstring: SLO Dashboard Tree View Provider Thin shell that wires the SLO data provider to the VS Code tree view. Health helpers and category builders live in ./sloBuilders. Type definitions and tree items live in ./sloTypes.
inline_comments: VS Code tree data provider for the SLO monitoring dashboard. Accepts any {@link SLODataProvider} for fetching data. During development you can pass the result of {@link SLODashboardProvider.createMockProvider} to get simulated values.
Returns an {@link SLODataProvider} that produces randomised but realistic SLO data. Useful for UI development without a running Agent SRE backend.
